name: 0 - The Fool
description:
Teleports Isaac back to the starting room of the floor.

Guaranteed to drop when destroying the Marked Skull in Depths.

name: I - The Magician
pickup_quote: May you never miss your goal
description:
+3 range for the current room.

Grants homing tears for the current room.

synergies.description: Also grants the effects of The Book of Belial.

name: II - The High Priestess
description:
Causes Mom's foot to stomp down on the enemy with the most health, dealing 300 damage.

If used in a room with no enemies, or against Mom, it will stomp Isaac instead.

synergies.description: Causes an additional foot to strike down shorty after the first one.

name: III - The Empress
description: Grants the effects of Whore of Babylon for the current room, activating them immediately.

synergies.description: Quadruples (4x) the damage boost, and doubles the speed boost.

name: IV - The Emperor
description:
Teleports Isaac to the current floor's Boss Room.

Acts as a random teleport if no Boss Room is available on the floor.

If Curse of the Labyrinth! is active, it will teleport Isaac to the second Boss Room.

synergies.description: Grants a Soul Heart if the floor's boss has not yet been defeated.

name: V - The Hierophant
description: Spawns 2 Soul Hearts.

name: VI - The Lovers
pickup_quote: May you prosper and be in good health
description: Spawns 2 Hearts.

name: VII - The Chariot
description: Grants the effects of My Little Unicorn for 6 seconds.

name: VIII - Justice
description:
Spawns a random heart, key, bomb, and coin.

Spawned pickups can be of any variant.

name: IX - The Hermit
pickup_quote: May you see what life has to offer
description:
Teleports Isaac to the current floor's Shop.

Acts as a random teleport if no Shop is available on the floor.

synergies.description: Prevents Greed from spawning in the shop. If Greed has already spawned, the shop will turn into a normal shop.

name: X - Wheel of Fortune
description:
Spawns a Slot Machine or Fortune Telling Machine.

Has a 1% chance to spawn a Crane Game instead.

name: XI - Strength
description:
Grants the effects of Magic Mushroom for the current room.

The extra heart container given from the item is not removed if it would kill Isaac.

synergies.description: Doubles the stat increases, except for the damage multiplier.

name: XII - The Hanged Man
description: Grants the effects of Transcendence for the current room.

name: XIII - Death
pickup_quote: Lay waste to all that oppose you
description: Activates The Necronomicon effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.

name: XIV - Temperance
pickup_quote: May you be pure in heart
description:
Spawns a Blood Donation Machine.

In Greed Mode, spawns a Devil Beggar instead.

name: XV - The Devil
pickup_quote: Revel in the power of darkness
description: Grants the effects of The Book of Belial for the current room.

synergies.description: Counts as having used The Book of Belial twice, resulting in an additional +1 damage.

name: XVI - The Tower
description: Spawns 6 Troll Bombs, essentially activating the effects of Anarchist Cookbook.

name: XVII - The Stars
pickup_quote: May you find what you desire
description:
Teleports Isaac to the Treasure Room, or the Planetarium, if one has spawned.

Acts as a random teleport if no Treasure Room is available on the floor.

If multiple Treasure Rooms are present, teleports to a random one.

synergies.description: If the Treasure Room has not been visited yet, it will have 2 items to choose from. Only one item can be taken. Will not work if teleported to the Planetarium.

name: XVIII - The Moon
pickup_quote: May you find all you have lost
description:
Teleports Isaac to the Secret Room.

Acts as a random teleport if no Secret Room is available on the floor.

If multiple Secret Rooms are present, teleports to a random one.

name: XIX - The Sun
pickup_quote: May the light heal and enlighten you
description:
Fully heals all of Isaac's Red Heart containers.

Deals 100 damage to all enemies in the room.

Reveals the entire floor map, except for the Super Secret Room and Ultra Secret Room.

Removes Curse of Darkness!.

synergies.description: Deals 200 damage to all enemies in the room twice.

name: XX - Judgement
description:
Spawns a Beggar.

The Beggar has a rare chance to be of a different variant.

name: XXI - The World
description: Reveals the entire floor map, except for the Super Secret Room and Ultra Secret Room.

name: 2 of Clubs
description: Doubles Isaac's bombs, or gives 2 if he doesn't have any.

name: 2 of Diamonds
description: Doubles Isaac's coins, or gives 2 if he doesn't have any.

name: 2 of Spades
description: Doubles Isaac's keys, or gives 2 if he doesn't have any.

name: 2 of Hearts
description: Doubles Isaac's current amount of filled red hearts, or fills one empty red heart container if all of them are empty.

name: Ace of Clubs
description: Turns all pickups, chests, and non-boss enemies in the room into random bombs.
unlock_text: Get a win streak of 3.

name: Ace of Diamonds
description: Turns all pickups, chests, and non-boss enemies in the room into random coins.
unlock: Defeat The Lamb in under 20 minutes.
unlock_text: Defeat The Lamb in under 20 minutes.

name: Ace of Spades
description: Turns all pickups, chests, and non-boss enemies in the room into random keys.
unlock: Defeat The Lamb without taking hearts, coins, or bombs through the entire run.
unlock_text: Defeat The Lamb without taking hearts, coins, or bombs through the entire run.

name: Ace of Hearts
description: Turns all pickups, chests, and non-boss enemies in the room into random hearts.
unlock: Complete an entire chapter after Basement while having a total of only half a heart or less. {{i|The Lost}} can be used for this.
unlock_text: Complete an entire chapter after Basement while having a total of only half a heart or less. The Lost can be used for this.

name: Joker
description:
Teleports Isaac to the Devil Room or Angel Room.

Also works if the floor cannot normally spawn such a room.

name: Hagalaz
description:
Destroys all obstacles in the room, excluding Metal Blocks, Pillars, and Key Blocks.

Also destroys stone enemies such as Stoneys and Stone Grimaces.

Destroys the armor of enemies such as Hosts, Knights, Tuff Twins, and The Shell.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #1: Pitch Black.

name: Jera
description:
Duplicates all pickups and chests in the room, excluding item pedestals.

Will also duplicate pickups that require payment, e.g. ones inside the shop.

Cloned chests will contain the exact same type of contents.

Cannot be used to clone other Jera runes, or trinkets.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #2: High Brow.

name: Ehwaz
description: Activates the effects of We Need To Go Deeper!, creating a trapdoor leading to the next floor, or a guaranteed Crawl Space if used on a special tile.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #3: Head Trauma.

name: Dagaz
description:
+1 Soul Heart.

Removes any curses on the current floor, except Curse of the Labyrinth!.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #4: Darkness Falls.

name: Ansuz
description: Reveals the entire map, except the Ultra Secret Room.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #5: The Tank.

name: Perthro
description: Activates the effects of The D6, rerolling all item pedestals in the room.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #6: Solar System.

name: Berkano
description: Spawns 3 Abyss locusts with a 1x damage multiplier for the duration of the room.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #20: Purist.

name: Algiz
description: Grants a shield similar to Book of Shadows that lasts for 20 seconds.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #8: Cat Got Your Tongue.

name: Blank Rune
description:
Grants a random rune effect.

Has a 25% chance to drop another Blank Rune upon use.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #30: The Guardian.

name: Black Rune
description:
Activates the effects of The Necronomicon, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.

Converts all pickups in the room into Blue Flies and Blue Spiders.

Converts all item pedestals in the room into random stat upgrades, similarly to consuming a passive item with Void. Will also consume active items but turn them into stats as well.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Apollyon.

name: Chaos Card
description:
Throws the card in the direction Isaac's body is facing (movement direction). Anything that crosses the card's path gets instantly destroyed, including enemies, bosses and obstacles.

The card has a short range, but can pass through multiple enemies.

Can also kill indestructible enemies, except Dark Esau.

Will blow open doors, just like a regular bomb explosion.

Cannot kill Delirium, The Beast, and Mother's Shadow.

Using it on some multi-phase bosses will only defeat their current phase: Satan (if used on the Fallen phase), Mega Satan, Hush, Ultra Greed, Mother, Dogma.

Using it on Great Gideon will reveal a secret crawlspace underneath him that contains several chests and items.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #9: Demo Man.

name: Credit Card
description:
Removes all price tags from items in the current room, making them instantly takeable without payment.

Works both for items that require coins or heart containers in order to purchase.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #10: Cursed!

name: Rules Card
description:
Displays a random message on the screen, similarly to a Fortune Telling Machine.

These messages will often contain hints, or special seeds.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #11: Glass Cannon.

name: A Card Against Humanity
description: Fills the entire room with poop.
unlock: Complete challenge #12: {{chal|When Life Gives You Lemons}}.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #12: When Life Gives You Lemons.

name: Suicide King
description: Instantly kills Isaac and spawns 10 pickups and/or items from the current room's item pool.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #7: Suicide King.

name: Get Out Of Jail Free Card
description: Opens all doors in the room, essentially activating the effects of Dad's Key.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #22: SPEED!

name: ? Card
description:
Activates Isaac's active item without wasting a charge, or making one-time-use items disappear.

Does not work for active items that are in the consumables slot.

When used with Blank Card, it will teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room, consuming both Blank Card and the ? Card in the process.

name: Dice Shard
description: Activates the effects of The D6 and D20 at the same time.

name: Emergency Contact
description:
Causes 2 of Mom's Hands to come down and grab 2 random enemies, dealing 40 damage to them.

If enemies have 40 or more HP, they are temporarily pinned to the ground, unable to move or shoot.

name: Holy Card
description: Grants a one-time-use Holy Mantle shield, that protects against one instance of damage.
unlock_text: Defeat Delirium as The Lost.

name: Huge Growth
description:
+7 flat damage.

+3 range.

+60% size. Does not affect the hitbox.

Grants Isaac the ability to crush obstacles by walking over them.

Effects last only for the current room.
unlock: Increase in size 5 times in a run by acquiring size-up items or consumables.
unlock_text: Increase in size 5 times in a run by acquiring size-up items or consumables.

name: Ancient Recall
description:
Spawns 3 random cards.

Can also spawn special cards, such as Cracked Key, Dice Shard, or Emergency Contact.
unlock_text: Use cards and runes 20 times.

name: Era Walk
description:
+0.5 speed.

-1 shot speed.

Slows down enemies.

Effects last for the current room.
unlock: Add both {{i|Broken Watch}} and {{i|Stop Watch}} to your collection page.
unlock_text: Add both Broken Watch and Stop Watch to your collection page.

name: Rune Shard
description:
Activates one of the following weaker rune effects:

• Algiz: grants a shield that lasts 3 seconds.

• Ansuz: reveals the map up to 3 rooms away from Isaac.

• Berkano: spawns an Abyss locust for the duration of the room.

• Dagaz: gives half a soul heart.

• Hagalaz: destroys only some rocks.

• Jera: duplicates only one pickup.

• Perthro: rerolls only one item.

Can spawn as a replacement for any other rune that hasn't been unlocked yet. This means that once all runes have been unlocked, Rune Shard will no longer be able to spawn.

name: 0 - The Fool?
description:
Drops all of Isaac's hearts and pickups on the ground, leaving him at only half a heart.

Dropped pickups may be combined in items equal to their worth, such as A Quarter, A Dollar, Boom!, and Skeleton Key.

synergies.description: Also drops Isaac's 6 most recently collected items.

unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Lost.

name: I - The Magician?
pickup_quote: May no harm come to you
description: Grants a blue aura that repels enemies and projectiles for 60 seconds, similar, but much stronger than The Soul.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Judas.

name: II - The High Priestess?
description: Causes Mom's leg to repeatedly stomp down on Isaac's location for 60 seconds.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Lilith.

name: III - The Empress?
description:
+2 full Red Heart containers.

+1.5 fire rate.

Effects last for 60 seconds.

If losing the heart containers gained from the card would result in killing Isaac, he will get left with only 1 heart instead.

synergies.description: Adds a total of 3 heart containers.

unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Eve.

name: IV - The Emperor?
pickup_quote: May you find a worthy opponent
description:
Teleports Isaac to an extra Boss Room that is not part of the floor layout. The room is chosen from the boss pool 2 floors deeper than the current floor (cannot be a final boss).

Defeating the extra boss will spawn an item normally, but no trap door or Devil/Angel Room can appear there. Isaac can exit the room normally to get back to where he was previously.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted ???.

name: V - The Hierophant?
description: Spawns 2 Bone Hearts.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Bethany.

name: VI - The Lovers?
pickup_quote: May your heart shatter into pieces
description: Activates the effects of Magic Skin, spawning a random item from the current room's item pool in exchange of converting a red heart container (or 2 soul hearts) into a Broken Heart.

synergies.description: Spawns 2 items in exchange for 2 Broken Hearts.

unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Magdalene.

name: VII - The Chariot?
description:
x4 fire rate multiplier.

Turns Isaac into an invulnerable statue that can be slightly moved.

Effects last for 10 seconds.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #42: Hot Potato.

name: VIII - Justice?
pickup_quote: May your sins come back to torment you
description: Spawns 2-4 Locked Chests.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #43: Cantripped!

name: IX - The Hermit?
pickup_quote: May you see the value of all things in life
description:
Sells all items and pickups on the ground for their usual Shop price, spawning a matching amount of coins.

If there is nothing to sell, spawns a single Penny instead.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #44: Red Redemption.

name: X - Wheel of Fortune?
description: Invokes a random Dice Room effect.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Cain.

name: XI - Strength?
description:
Slows all enemies in the room and causes them to take double damage from all sources.

The effects lasts for 60 seconds, or until the room is left.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Samson.

name: XII - The Hanged Man?
pickup_quote: May your greed know no bounds
description:
Isaac visually turns into Keeper for 30 seconds, gaining triple shot, and -0.1 speed.

Enemies killed by the converted character while the effect is active drop random coins.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Keeper.

name: XIII - Death?
pickup_quote: May life spring forth from the fallen
description: Activates the effects of Book of the Dead, turning enemies killed in the room into bone familiars or friendly Bonies.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Forgotten.

name: XIV - Temperance?
description: Forces Isaac to eat 5 random pills in quick succession.
unlock_text: Complete challenge #45: DELETE THIS.

name: XV - The Devil?
pickup_quote: Bask in the light of your mercy
description: Activates the effects of The Bible, and grants a Seraphim familiar for 30 seconds.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Azazel.

name: XVI - The Tower?
description:
Creates up to 7 clusters of random rocks and other obstacles.

These clusters will often contain tinted rocks, with the possibility of more than one tinted rock appearing in the same room.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Apollyon.

name: XVII - The Stars?
description:
Spawns 2 random items from the current room's item pool in exchange for Isaac's oldest passive item.

Starting items are ignored and cannot be removed.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Isaac.

name: XVIII - The Moon?
description:
Teleports Isaac to the Ultra Secret Room, creating a pathway back to normal rooms via red rooms.

Acts as a random teleport if no Ultra Secret Room is available on the floor.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Jacob.

name: XIX - The Sun?
pickup_quote: May the darkness swallow all around you
description:
+1.5 damage.

Turns Isaac's red heart containers into Bone Hearts.

Grants Spirit of the Night.

Applies Curse of Darkness!.

Effects last for the current floor.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Jacob.

name: XX - Judgement?
pickup_quote: May you redeem those found wanting
description: Spawns a Shop Restock Machine.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Lazarus.

name: XXI - The World?
description: Spawns a trapdoor that leads to a Crawl Space.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greedier as Tainted Eden.

name: Cracked Key
description:
Activates the effects of Red Key, creating a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall.

Can be created by dropping any trinket in a Boss Room or Treasure Room prior to picking up Dad's Note. Trinkets dropped in these rooms will convert to Cracked Key during the Ascent floors.
unlock: Open {{i|Mom's Chest}} in the Home level.
unlock_text: Open Mom's Chest in the Home level.

name: Queen of Hearts
description: Spawns 1-20 Hearts.
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Magdalene.

name: Wild Card
description: Copies the effect of the most recently used active item or consumable.
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Eden.

name: Soul of Isaac
description: Causes all item pedestals in the current room to cycle between the original item and an additional one.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Isaac}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Isaac.

name: Soul of Magdalene
description: For the rest of the room, causes enemies to drop Half Hearts upon death that disappear after 2 seconds.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Magdalene}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Magdalene.

name: Soul of Cain
description:
Opens all doors in the room, and creates Red Key rooms on all valid walls.

Will destroy the entrance to the Mirrored World in Downpour / Dross II.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Cain}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Cain.

name: Soul of Judas
description: Invokes the Dark Arts effect for 3 seconds, stopping time for 3 seconds and allowing Isaac to pass through enemies and projectiles, dealing damage to them and gaining a temporary damage bonus.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Judas}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Judas.

name: Soul of ???
description:
Causes 8 poison farts that leave damaging brown creep on the ground, then plants a trail of 7 Butt Bombs in quick succession.

Standing on the creep grants +1.5 fire rate and +1 damage.

The creep deals Isaac's amount of damage at a very fast rate.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted ???}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted ???.

name: Soul of Eve
description: Spawns 14 Dead Bird familiars for the current room.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Eve}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Eve.

name: Soul of Samson
description: Grants the Berserk! ability for 10 seconds.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Samson}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Samson.

name: Soul of Azazel
description: Activates Mega Blast for 7.5 seconds.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Azazel}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Azazel.

name: Soul of Lazarus
description:
Kills and revives Isaac at half a heart in the same room, with some invincibility time.

The soul stone is automatically used upon taking fatal damage, essentially serving as an extra life.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Lazarus}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Lazarus.

name: Soul of Eden
description: Activates the effects of The D6 and D20, but rerolled items are pulled from random item pools.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Eden}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Eden.

name: Soul of the Lost
description:
Isaac dies and visually turns into The Lost, with all of his benefits and weaknesses, until leaving the room.

This allows Isaac to take a Devil Deal for free, take one free hit due to the Holy Mantle, and enter the Mausoleum / Gehenna door for free.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Lost}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Lost.

name: Soul of Lilith
description: Grants a permanent passive item familiar from the Baby Shop item pool.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Lilith}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Lilith.

name: Soul of the Keeper
description: Spawns 1-25 random coins.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Keeper}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Keeper.

name: Soul of Apollyon
description: Spawns 15 random 7 Seals locusts.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Apollyon}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Apollyon.

name: Soul of the Forgotten
description: Spawns The Forgotten as a temporary secondary character, that can be controlled by the same inputs as Isaac, and dies if his 3 Bone Hearts run out, or Isaac leaves the room.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Forgotten}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Forgotten.

name: Soul of Bethany
description: Spawns 6 random Book of Virtues wisps.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Bethany}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Bethany.

name: Soul of Jacob and Esau
description:
Spawns Esau as a temporary secondary character, that can be controlled by the same inputs as Isaac, and dies if his health runs out, or Isaac leaves the room.

Esau receives items equal to the number of items Isaac has, each based on the pool of the items Isaac's were obtained from.
unlock: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as {{i|Tainted Jacob}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush and complete Boss Rush as Tainted Jacob.

name: Bad Gas
type_label:
Pill
Class: 1+
Minor, situational
Positive effect
description:
Isaac farts, dealing 5 damage and poisoning nearby enemies.

The poison deals Isaac's amount of damage for 6 ticks.

Horse pill: The fart affects the entire room.

name: Bad Trip
type_label:
Pill
Class: 2-

Negative effect
description:
Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac.

This damage doesn't affect the Devil Deal chance.

If Isaac would die from this damage, the pill instead converts to Full Health.

Horse pill: Deals 2 full hearts of damage.

name: Balls of Steel
type_label:
Pill

Medium, significant impact

description:
+2 Soul Hearts.

Horse pill: +4 Soul Hearts.

name: Bombs are Key
type_label:
Pill
Class: 2
Medium, significant impact
Neutral effect
description:
Swaps Isaac's keys and bombs.

Also swaps his Golden Bomb and Golden Key.

As Tainted ???, swaps poops and keys.

Horse pill: Increases the amount of bombs and keys by 50% when swapping.

type_label:
Pill

Minor, situational
Neutral effect
description:
Spawns 5 active bombs behind Isaac, one per half a second.

Horse pill: Spawns 8 active bombs that have the Mr. Mega and Bobby-Bomb upgrades.

type_label:
Pill

description:
Fully heals Isaac.

Horse pill: Additionally grants +3 Soul Hearts.

description:
-1 Red Heart container.

Horse pill: Removes 2 Red Heart conatiners.

Positive effect
description:
+1 empty Red Heart container.

name: I Found Pills
description: No effect, purely cosmetic.

name: Puberty
description: No effect, purely cosmetic.

Pill

Positive effect
description:
Spawns a permanent fly orbital that blocks projectiles and instantly kills certain fly-type enemies.

Up to 3 flies can be obtained.

Horse pill: Spawns a Big Fan familiar, with no upper limit.

-1 luck.

+1 luck.

Horse pill: +2 luck.

name: Telepills
type_label:
Pill
Class: 1
Minor, situational
Neutral effect
description:
Teleports Isaac to a random room.

Has a small chance to teleport to the I AM ERROR room, and a small chance for the Black Market.

When used in the mirrored version of Downpour / Dross II, has a chance to teleport to the Ultra Secret Room.

Horse pill: Guarantees a teleport to a special room.

name: 48 Hour Energy!
type_label:
Pill
Class: 2+
Medium, significant impact
Positive effect
description:
Fully recharges Isaac's active item.

Spawns a Lil' Battery.

Has a chance to spawn an additional Micro Battery.

Horse pill: Spawns 3-4 Lil' Batteries.

name: Hematemesis
type_label:
Pill
Class: 2
Medium, significant impact
Neutral effect
description:
Empties all but 1 red heart container and spawns 1-4 Hearts.
